# Erdos.p101 — Erdős problem 101

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/101
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/101.lean`, theorem `erdos_101`, AMS 52).

Given $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$, no five of which are on a line, the number of
lines containing four points is $o(n^2)$.

## Statement
(fun n => (numLinesWithFourPointMax n : ℝ)) =o[atTop] (fun n => (n : ℝ)^2)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
